probes.prompt: /ckeditor:ckeditor Use the ckeditor skill to integrate a free, GPL-licensed Classic CKEditor 5 into a minimal static project using the npm single-package model. Headless authoring task: no browser, no npm install, no network calls; only author files. Write index.html containing a text element with id="editor" and a preview container using the ck-content class for saved editor output. Write editor.js that imports the editor class from 'ckeditor5', imports 'ckeditor5/ckeditor5.css', and calls ClassicEditor.create on the #editor element with a config that loads the plugins its toolbar needs and a toolbar containing bold and italic, and sets the license key for free use to 'GPL'. Free setup only: do not import or reference ckeditor5-premium-features. Use only what the skill and its bundled reference files document; do not fetch live docs. Then read the immutable verify_ckeditor.py and run exactly python verify_ckeditor.py using Bash; that validates the integration structure and writes ckeditor-verification.json. Do not modify the verifier or read/write its skill output file with model tools; the runner inspects it directly. This is the only allowed Bash command, without prefixes, suffixes, redirection or extra shell operations. Final response: list the produced files and report the actual verifier result, and state that browser rendering remains untested in this headless task.

fixtures.text:
import json
from pathlib import Path

editor = Path('editor.js').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
page = Path('index.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert 'ClassicEditor.create' in editor, 'editor must be created via ClassicEditor.create'
assert 'ckeditor5/ckeditor5.css' in editor, 'editor CSS not imported'
assert 'licenseKey' in editor and chr(39) + 'GPL' + chr(39) in editor, 'free use requires GPL license key'
assert chr(39) + 'bold' + chr(39) in editor and chr(39) + 'italic' + chr(39) in editor, 'toolbar must contain bold and italic'
assert 'Bold' in editor and 'Italic' in editor, 'bold and italic plugins must be loaded'
assert 'ckeditor5-premium-features' not in editor, 'free setup must not import premium features'
assert 'id="editor"' in page, 'index.html must contain the editor element'
assert 'ck-content' in page, 'saved-output container must use the ck-content class'
report = {'classic_create': True, 'css_loaded': True, 'free_gpl_license': True,
          'no_premium_import': True, 'plugins_match_toolbar': True, 'preview_container': True}
Path('ckeditor-verification.json').write_bytes((json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True) + '\n').encode('utf-8'))
print('CKEditor integration: single-package free setup checks passed; browser rendering remains untested')
